hardware: Windows / Ryzen 9 9950X / 128 GiB RAM / RTX 5090 32 GiB
method: Fresh engine per variant; four warmup requests and five timed repeats; 39 prompt / 64 output tokens, greedy, ctx2048/batch16/threads4, IQ3_XXS. Sequential order 0,1,2,3, then old-profile control; OS file cache not cleared. Decode tokens/s = 63*1000/DONE.decode_ms, excluding startup and prefill but including draft/verify/repair. A single prompt is not a general optimum or a statistically isolated allocator test.

selected_profile.reason: No measured speed benefit from MTP 1; user prefers avoiding draft resource cost. MTP 0 provides more main-expert cache within the same 95% global RAM/VRAM targets.

memory_note: Cache numbers are medians of post-request snapshots, not device allocation peaks. Freed MTP capacity goes to main cache; lower total power consumption was not measured.

report.timing: (output tokens - 1) * 1000 / DONE.decode_ms; excludes load/warmup/prefill, includes target sampling, draft, verify, repair and pipe writes
report.scope: one saved prompt, sequential engines, OS file cache not cleared
